items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: I knew about it because I was playing with Sheik, Kit Sheik.

ctx.x: Did you ever play on another boat beside the Madison?

Steamer Madison? I played one time on the Steamer Cap'n. I played more than playing piano on there, but he got sick one night and he had me to come to the place. He would just play for that. I wanted to ask you, where were you when Lindbergh crossed Atlanta? Where I was? I was in New York City then. You were in New York City then? I went there. I was in New York City. Did you see the Tick-a-Tape parade and all that? No I didn't get a chance to see it because I was in school. And where were you when the Depression…
Do you remember a boat called the Camellia? What?
